title: Find a tote on the Container Selection screen by typing the Location number
summary: Use the Container Selection screen’s Location search to locate a tote by typing the Location number, then select the rack or AGV where the tote is located (when it is present in the system).
when_to_use: When you need to find where a specific tote is located in the system and you have a Location number to search on the Container Selection screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the tote lookup on the Container Selection screen using the Location number search and select the rack/AGV shown for that location.
access_or_tools_needed: Location number input field on the screen

system_preconditions: The tote must be present in the system for the entered Location number to return tote/container information.

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen frame showing tote/container color indicators and the Location-number lookup instruction text.

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen
steps.purpose: Access the Container Selection UI where Location search is available.
steps.instruction: Open the Container Selection screen in the OptiSweep interface.
steps.expected_result: The Container Selection screen is displayed and ready for Location search input.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Container Selection UI elements used for tote/container lookup (including the Location search area).
steps.failure_condition: The Container Selection screen is not accessible or the Location search input area is not available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source describes using the Container Selection screen to find a tote by typing the Location number and selecting the rack or AGV it’s located on if it’s in the system.

steps.title: Use the Location search by typing the Location number
steps.purpose: Filter the Container Selection map to the rack/AGV associated with the entered Location number.
steps.instruction: In the Container Selection screen, type the Location number into the Location input/search field.
steps.expected_result: The UI is positioned to show the rack or AGV associated with the entered Location number (if the tote/container exists in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: After entering the Location number, the screen is ready to select the rack/AGV for that location.
steps.failure_condition: No rack/AGV tote/container information is shown for the entered Location number.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “You can also find a tote by typing the … Location [number] in …”

steps.title: Select the rack or AGV where the tote is located
steps.purpose: Open the tote/container details for the rack/AGV associated with the entered Location number.
steps.instruction: Select the rack or AGV shown for that Location number on the Container Selection screen.
steps.expected_result: The screen updates to show the tote/container information for the selected rack/AGV at that location (when the tote is in the system).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected rack/AGV corresponds to the tote/container present at that location (the tote/container is found “if its in the system”).
steps.failure_condition: Selecting the rack/AGV does not produce tote/container information for that Location number.

actions.label: Select rack/AGV
actions.exact_action: selecting the rack or AGV … it’s located on if its in the system

stop_or_escalate_if: If no tote/container information appears for the entered Location number, stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “...selecting the rack or AGV … it’s located on if its in the system.”

steps.title: Confirm the screen updates to show tote/container information for that location
steps.purpose: Verify the lookup succeeded and the correct tote/container is displayed for the selected rack/AGV.
steps.instruction: Verify the Container Selection screen shows the tote/container details for the selected rack/AGV at the entered Location number.
steps.expected_result: The screen shows the tote/container information for that location (i.e., the tote is found “if it’s in the system”).
steps.healthy_condition: The selected rack/AGV displays tote/container presence information consistent with the UI’s tote/container indicators (e.g., dark blue indicates presence of a tote; light blue indicates an empty rack).
steps.failure_condition: The screen does not show tote/container information for the entered Location number.

actions.label: Verify tote/container display
actions.exact_action: Confirm the screen updates to show the tote/container information for that location

stop_or_escalate_if: If no tote/container information appears for the entered Location number, stop and escalate for further investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR on the Container Selection screen: “Dark blue indicates the presence of a … tote. While light blue represents empty … rack.” and the Location-number lookup instruction.

success_criteria: After typing the Location number and selecting the rack/AGV, the Container Selection screen shows tote/container information for that location (tote found “if its in the system”).
healthy_conditions: Dark blue indicates the presence of a tote; light blue represents an empty rack on the Container Selection screen.
Selecting the rack/AGV associated with the entered Location number results in tote/container information being displayed.
failure_conditions: No tote/container information appears for the entered Location number.
escalation_guidance: If no tote/container information appears for the entered Location number, stop and escalate for further investigation.
